evidence: Default framework AppWorld Dockerfile sets APPWORLD_ROOT=/world but no WORKDIR.
Native appworld download data returned0 and wrote ./data under default cwd/, producing /data.
impact: Automatic default data preparation can fail on standard Docker too; separate from platform bind-mount namespace limitation.
suggested_public_fix: Run native downloader with explicit --workdir /world, preserving public API, native data and verifier.
current_smoke_mode: Use declared benchmark.data_path with unchanged full native cache copied from actual /data; this validates that supported mode, not automatic-download path.

resolution.change: Add --workdir /world to native downloader Docker run; no public API/native data/scorer changes.
resolution.regression_before_fix: Native cwd-aware cache simulation reproduced previous exit0-without-mounted-data failure.
